en.content: The total number of amines among the following which can be synthesized by Gabriel synthesis is __________.
en.explanation:
Gabriel phthalimide synthesis is used to prepare 1o aliphatic or alicyclic amine. Hence, amine which can be synthesised by Gabriel phthalimide synthesis method contains -carbon.

Aniline (C6H5NH2) does not contain -C cannot be prepared by Gabriel reaction.

Remaining amines all contain -C in its respective position, hence they can easily give Gabriel phthalimide reaction.
